digest.component_or_area: configuration ownership and legacy facade removal (RP-04)
propositions: An AST ownership gate must be created to enforce that configuration and credential reads occur only through approved composition roots/provider boundaries, rejecting direct ambient access patterns like load_config, os.getenv, os.environ variants, and backend property reloads.

Synthetic test fixtures must exist for all prohibited access forms (direct, import/local aliases, attribute/subscript getattr) and deliberately unowned registry names, each failing with path, symbol, access kind, and owning seam diagnostics.

The ownership gate must be integrated into make lint and CI workflows, with parity tests ensuring both the ownership gate and field-consumption gate (check_config_reads.py) execute; legacy exception set must be empty before close.

Configuration and security lifecycle documentation must be generated and byte-current from authoritative schema and ownership registries, covering precedence, sources, restart rotation, observability, subprocess limits, and provider deltas.

Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job paths, ambient reloads, and exception entries must be removed only after all focused behavioral suites and bounded live canaries (provider, AWS op-cert, reconciler) pass with redacted evidence and no credential leakage.
